name: Quodd
tagline: Institutional market data APIs for equities, options, and related feeds
description: Quodd (QUODD Financial Information Services) provides market data APIs for equities, options, and related financial datasets used by platforms and applications. Access is typically commercial and credentialed; public self-serve developer docs and free tiers are limited or not clearly published. Verify current base URL, auth, and product endpoints with Quodd sales or partner documentation before integration.

auth.details: Commercial/partner credentials; public self-serve auth method not clearly documented on the marketing site

pricing.paid_plans: Enterprise/commercial pricing; contact Quodd sales (not published self-serve)

example.response_snippet: Official public request/response examples were not found on the marketing site; obtain sample payloads from Quodd partner docs or account onboarding.

use_cases: look up equity quotes for a ticker
retrieve options chain or options market data
integrate delayed or real-time market data into a financial app
power portfolio or watchlist market data displays
